title: Present simple + in / on / at
title_it: Present simple e in / on / at
goal: Talk about routines and facts, and use at, on and in with time.
goal_it: Parlare di routine e fatti e usare at, on e in con il tempo.

title: Present continuous
title_it: Present continuous
goal: Talk about what is happening now and use the -ing form correctly.
goal_it: Parlare di ciò che sta accadendo adesso e usare correttamente la forma -ing.

title: Listening: A phone call at the station
title_it: Ascolto: una telefonata alla stazione
goal: Understand a short phone call, and practise telling the time and the present continuous.
goal_it: Capire una breve telefonata ed esercitare l'ora e il present continuous.

title: Present simple vs continuous + adverbs of frequency
title_it: Present simple vs continuous + avverbi di frequenza
goal: Choose between present simple and continuous and place adverbs of frequency correctly.
goal_it: Scegliere tra present simple e continuous e collocare correttamente gli avverbi di frequenza.

title: Writing: A typical day
title_it: Scrittura: una giornata tipica
goal: Write about your daily routine with the present simple, frequency adverbs and the present continuous.
goal_it: Scrivere della tua routine con present simple, avverbi di frequenza e present continuous.

title: Weekly check: present simple and continuous
title_it: Verifica della settimana: present simple e continuous
goal: Check the week: present simple, present continuous, in / on / at and adverbs of frequency, plus a short reading.
goal_it: Verificare la settimana: present simple, present continuous, in / on / at e avverbi di frequenza, più una breve lettura.

title: Sunday review: present simple and continuous
title_it: Ripasso della domenica: present simple e continuous
goal: Review the week: choose between present simple and continuous, avoid the common traps, and listen to something light.
goal_it: Ripassare la settimana: scegliere tra present simple e continuous, evitare le trappole più comuni e ascoltare qualcosa di leggero.

title: Past simple + prepositions of place + question words
title_it: Past simple + preposizioni di luogo + parole interrogative
goal: Talk about finished past actions, say where things are, and ask questions with where, when, who, why, which and whose.
goal_it: Parlare di azioni passate finite, dire dove sono le cose e fare domande con where, when, who, why, which e whose.

title: Past continuous + question words 2 + this / that
title_it: Past continuous + parole interrogative 2 + this / that
goal: Say what was happening at a moment in the past, ask how much, how many, how far, how long and how often, and use this, these, that and those.
goal_it: Dire cosa stava succedendo in un momento del passato, fare domande con how much, how many, how far, how long e how often, e usare this, these, that e those.

title: Listening: A new flat
title_it: Ascolto: un nuovo appartamento
goal: Understand a phone call about a new flat, and practise there is / there are, prepositions of place and the past simple.
goal_it: Capire una telefonata su un nuovo appartamento ed esercitare there is / there are, le preposizioni di luogo e il past simple.

title: Present perfect 1 + countable and uncountable + which tense?
title_it: Present perfect 1 + countable e uncountable + quale tempo?
goal: Use the present perfect for news and results, choose between past simple, past continuous and present perfect, and use a / an, some / any and much / many.
goal_it: Usare il present perfect per notizie e risultati, scegliere tra past simple, past continuous e present perfect, e usare a / an, some / any e much / many.

title: Writing: My home and my weekend
title_it: Scrittura: la mia casa e il mio weekend
goal: Describe your home with there is / there are, a lot of, much and many and place prepositions, then write a past simple weekend diary.
goal_it: Descrivere la tua casa con there is / there are, a lot of, much e many e preposizioni di luogo, poi scrivere un diario del weekend al past simple.

title: Weekly check: past simple, past continuous and present perfect
title_it: Verifica della settimana: past simple, past continuous e present perfect
goal: Check the week: choose between past simple, past continuous and present perfect, plus place words, question words, countable and uncountable nouns, and a short reading.
goal_it: Verificare la settimana: scelta tra past simple, past continuous e present perfect, più parole di luogo, parole interrogative, countable e uncountable e una breve lettura.

title: Sunday review: past simple, past continuous and present perfect
title_it: Ripasso della domenica: past simple, past continuous e present perfect
goal: Review the week: choose between the three tenses, avoid the common traps, and listen to something light.
goal_it: Ripassare la settimana: scegliere tra i tre tempi, evitare le trappole più comuni e ascoltare qualcosa di leggero.

title: Present perfect 2 + pronouns + no double negatives
title_it: Present perfect 2 (esperienze), pronomi e doppia negazione
goal: Talk about experiences up to now with ever, never, just, already, yet and still, use subject and object pronouns, and avoid double negatives.
goal_it: Parlare di esperienze fino a ora con ever, never, just, already, yet e still, usare i pronomi soggetto e complemento ed evitare la doppia negazione.

title: Present perfect with for / since + possessives + Saxon genitive
title_it: Present perfect con for e since, possessivi e genitivo sassone
goal: Say how long a situation has lasted with for, since and how long, use possessive adjectives and pronouns, and use the Saxon genitive.
goal_it: Dire da quanto tempo dura una situazione con for, since e how long, usare aggettivi e pronomi possessivi e il genitivo sassone.

title: Listening: planning a trip
title_it: Ascolto: organizzare un viaggio
goal: Understand two friends planning a holiday, and notice the present perfect for experiences, the past simple for a story, going to, would like to and will for plans, and possessive pronouns.
goal_it: Capire due amici che organizzano una vacanza e notare il present perfect per le esperienze, il past simple per una storia, going to, would like to e will per i progetti e i pronomi possessivi.

title: Present perfect continuous + going to, would like to, will + love/like -ing
title_it: Present perfect continuous, going to, would like to, will e love/like + -ing
goal: Talk about activities that last up to now, say plans, wishes and quick decisions, and use love, like, hate, enjoy with -ing, while keeping all the tenses fresh.
goal_it: Parlare di attivita' che durano fino a ora, esprimere progetti, desideri e decisioni al momento, usare love, like, hate, enjoy con -ing e ripassare tutti i tempi.

title: Writing: A holiday email
title_it: Scrittura: l'email di una vacanza
goal: Write a holiday email using the present perfect, the past simple and going to, with no, a little / a few, too much / too many and here / there.
goal_it: Scrivere l'email di una vacanza con present perfect, past simple e going to, usando no, a little / a few, too much / too many e here / there.

title: Phrasal verbs of the week
title_it: Phrasal verbs della settimana
goal: Learn ten useful phrasal verbs and see how to use them in different sentences.
goal_it: Imparare dieci phrasal verbs utili e vedere come usarli in frasi diverse.

title: Phrasal verbs of the week
title_it: Phrasal verbs della settimana
goal: Learn ten more phrasal verbs for travel and daily life and see how to use them in different sentences.
goal_it: Imparare altri dieci phrasal verbs per viaggi e vita quotidiana e vedere come usarli in frasi diverse.

title: Reading: At the airport
title_it: Lettura: All'aeroporto
goal: Check in, pass security and find your gate.
goal_it: Fare il check-in e trovare il gate.

title: Reading: Asking for directions
title_it: Lettura: Chiedere e dare indicazioni
goal: Ask the way and understand the answer.
goal_it: Chiedere la strada e capire la risposta.

title: Reading: At a restaurant
title_it: Lettura: Al ristorante
goal: Book a table, order food and ask for the bill.
goal_it: Prenotare, ordinare e chiedere il conto.

title: Reading: Shopping for clothes
title_it: Lettura: Fare shopping per i vestiti
goal: Ask for a size, try something on and pay.
goal_it: Chiedere una taglia, provare un capo e pagare.

title: Reading: At the doctor's and at the pharmacy
title_it: Lettura: Dal medico e in farmacia
goal: Describe simple symptoms and understand advice and instructions.
goal_it: Descrivere sintomi semplici e capire consigli e istruzioni.

title: Reading: At the hotel
title_it: Lettura: In albergo
goal: Check in, ask about breakfast and report problems in your room.
goal_it: Fare il check-in, chiedere della colazione e segnalare problemi in camera.

title: Reading: Meeting people at a party
title_it: Lettura: Conoscere persone a una festa
goal: Introduce yourself, make small talk and talk about past experiences at a British party.
goal_it: Presentarti, fare due chiacchiere e parlare di esperienze passate a una festa britannica.

title: Reading: Making plans with a friend
title_it: Lettura: Fare un piano con un amico
goal: Talk about plans, wishes and experiences with going to, would like to, will and the present perfect.
goal_it: Parlare di progetti, desideri ed esperienze con going to, would like to, will e il present perfect.

title: Reading: Train and bus tickets
title_it: Lettura: Biglietti di treno e autobus
goal: Understand the main types of British train ticket and buy a ticket politely at the station.
goal_it: Capire i principali tipi di biglietto del treno britannico e comprarne uno con gentilezza in stazione.

title: Yellow
title_it: Yellow
goal: Learn the words first, notice irregular past verbs and would, and think about what the narrator does for love.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota i verbi irregolari al passato e would, e pensa a cosa fa il narratore per amore.

title: Young and Beautiful
title_it: Young and Beautiful
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, when and the present perfect, and think about what the song really asks.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, when e il present perfect e pensa a cosa chiede davvero la canzone.

title: Starlight
title_it: Starlight
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, if-clauses and the present continuous, and think about what the singer wants to hold on to.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, le frasi con if e il present continuous, e pensa a cosa vuole tenere stretto il cantante.

title: This Is the Life
title_it: This Is the Life
goal: Learn the words first, notice the past continuous and going to, and think about what a night out really feels like.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota il past continuous e going to, e pensa a cosa si prova davvero in una serata fuori.

title: Have You Ever Seen the Rain?
title_it: Have You Ever Seen the Rain?
goal: Learn the words first, notice Have you ever and the present perfect continuous, and think about what rain on a sunny day stands for.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota Have you ever e il present perfect continuous, e pensa a cosa rappresenta la pioggia in una giornata di sole.

title: Haven't Met You Yet
title_it: Haven't Met You Yet
goal: Learn the words first, notice haven't ... yet and the way the song talks about the future, and think about the difference between waiting and hoping.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota haven't ... yet e il modo in cui la canzone parla del futuro, e pensa alla differenza tra aspettare e sperare.
